title: Ford Explorer Engines by Year (1991–2026)
description: Every factory engine in the Ford Explorer by year, 1991–2026: the 4.0 V6s, 5.0 and 4.6 V8s, the 3.5 and EcoBoost engines, the hybrid and Police Interceptor.
intro: Ford's Explorer replaced the Bronco II for 1991 and has been the best-selling SUV in America for much of its life. The two-door Explorer Sport and the Explorer Sport Trac pickup are included; Police Interceptor Utility engines are marked, and hybrid ratings are for engine and motor combined.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.

generations.name: Second generation
intro: The 4.0 OHV and, from 1997, the 4.0 SOHC V6, plus the 5.0 Windsor V8.

generations.name: Third generation
intro: The 4.0 SOHC V6 and the 4.6 Modular V8.

generations.name: Fourth generation
intro: The 4.0 SOHC V6 and the 4.6 three-valve V8.

generations.name: Fifth generation
intro: The 3.5 V6, the 2.0 and 2.3 EcoBoost fours, the 3.5 EcoBoost, and the Police Interceptor's 3.7.

generations.name: Sixth generation
intro: The 2.3 EcoBoost, the 3.0 EcoBoost V6 in the ST and top trims, and the 3.3 hybrid.
